scope: Fixed CPU compositing fixtures in EC-0

cases.fill: Opaque red rectangle becomes green. Exterior remains transparent.
cases.blur: White rectangle gains an alpha halo. Horizontal edge samples increase inward and mirrored samples agree within one byte.
cases.vectors: Green and red native paths overlap. Red paints in front. Exclusive regions retain each path's color.
cases.trim: First half of a left-to-right open path is painted. Second half is transparent.
cases.morph: Equal-topology native rectangle keys translate the path 64px over one second. The middle pose is halfway.
cases.mask: Rectangular Add mask with a smaller Subtract hole.
cases.alpha-matte: Invisible black matte reveals target inside its alpha coverage.
cases.luma-matte: Invisible black matte suppresses the target. White control matte reveals it.
cases.precomp-parent: Nested composition renders a child translated by a 2D null.

checks: Identical PNG hashes per case across thread counts
